description: Severity policy for the content guardrails in question_bank/src/question_bank/content_lint.py. Every check starts as a warning because existing content still triggers it. To promote a check after the content is fixed, either set its severity to "error" (whole catalogue) or add bank keys, course keys or stable keys to error_scopes (a trailing * matches a prefix, for example "g3-sec1-n5-*"). See docs/plan/CONTENT_LINT_GUARDRAILS.md.

content_control_character.notes: Audit baseline: Sec 1 N5 (9 questions) and Sec 2 S1 (5 questions).

content_float_noise.notes: Audit baseline: Sec 2 S1 C-01 to C-03 and C-06 (10 questions), Sec 1 N1 C-12 (1).

content_math_duplicate.notes: Heuristic signature match; review each pair before rewriting.

content_plain_text_math.notes: Plain linear equations such as 'x = 5' in prose are deliberately not flagged.

content_hint_reveals_answer.notes: Only answers stated as a result are detected; see the known limits.

content_answer_solution_mismatch.notes: Audit baseline: Sec 2 G4 C1 (g4-l2-529) and Sec 2 G5 liquid-depth items (g5-l4-507, g5-l4-514).
